name: collapse-tools
description: Draws each tool call as one line, [+] Name  arg, with the name in a color you can change. Click a row to expand it, or run /collapse-tools to toggle all. Haiku summaries (on by default) replace the raw argument with a short label.

doneColor.title: Completed call color
doneColor.description: Color of the tool name when a call completed successfully (running calls are yellow, errors red). Theme key or color, for example white, gray, cyan, #7d9a83. Default white.

summaries.title: Haiku summaries
summaries.description: Replace long or multi-step tool arguments on collapsed rows with a short Haiku summary. Default on.
